test_title: PYST 45: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
D, E, F, H, I, J and K are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between E and J when counted from the right of E. Only two people sit between J and F. Only three people sit between E and I. D sits to the immediate left of K.

Who sits third to the left of H?
solution:
Given: D, E, F, H, I, J and K are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. 

1) Only two people sit between E and J when counted from the right of E.

2) Only two people sit between J and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37137daf5989635892ac773257fa931c19d165eae07ad14c3260aecb992eec28.png] 

3) Only three people sit between E and I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf40f1ba4aa3cac267d80fcbf4ed93584d38e1e4102061a0f25f4d8e26873d7c.png] 

4 ) D sits to the immediate left of K.

After positioning D and K only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e59f259d911f4b4b19b2d0e317ce2082ae66b3a7461e566fdcbd7df0f32ad526.png] 

Thus, K sits third to the left of H.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
